items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Hardening Container Storage with Bind Mount Options and EmptyDir Permissions
items.blurb: Kubernetes v1.37 brings important storage security features: emptyDir permission modes and bind mount options.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod-Level Resource Managers graduated to Beta
items.blurb: With the release of Kubernetes v1.37, the Pod-Level Resource Managers feature has graduated to Beta status (disabled by default)!

items.title: Kubernetes Changed Block Tracking API - Beta Differences
items.blurb: Changed Block Tracking (CBT) support for CSI drivers shipped as Alpha in September 2025. With the March 2026 v1.0.0 release of the external-snapshot-metadata project, the feature moved to Beta .

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Memory QoS Graduates to Beta
items.blurb: Memory QoS has graduated to Beta in Kubernetes v1.37 and is now enabled by default. On Linux nodes running cgroup v2, the feature uses the memory controller to give the kernel better guidance on how to treat container memory.

items.title: Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Project Karmada Reaches CNCF Graduation
items.blurb: The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) announced on September 2026 that Karmada, a multi-cluster and multi-cloud Kubernetes orchestration project, has graduated.

items.title: Microsoft Open-Sources TauGrid to Simplify AI Workload Management on Kubernetes
items.blurb: Microsoft has open-sourced TauGrid, a cloud-native platform designed to manage, schedule, and monitor AI workloads on GPU-enabled Kubernetes clusters. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Lyft Moves Streaming Fleet to Apache Flink Kubernetes Operator
items.blurb: Lyft has moved hundreds of production Flink jobs from a 2020 in-house Kubernetes operator to the Apache Flink Kubernetes Operator, unlocking last-state upgrades, in-place autoscaling and resource autotuning across the fleet.
